title: Bee Removal in Corona, Queens
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Corona, Queens. Licensed pest control serving homes and businesses in Corona.
intro: Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services throughout Corona, Queens, protecting homes and businesses from active nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, and structural wood. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: We've served Corona residents for years with safe, effective bee removal that prioritizes both your safety and environmental responsibility. Our experienced team understands the unique challenges of Queens properties, from single-family homes near Corona Plaza to apartment buildings along Roosevelt Avenue, and we respond quickly to bee emergencies throughout the area.
localContext: Corona's diverse mix of residential homes, busy commercial corridors like Roosevelt Avenue, and proximity to Flushing Meadows Corona Park creates ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies to establish paper nests in walls, attics, and building overhangs. Yellow jackets commonly nest in the ground around older foundations, and carpenter bees drill galleries into the fascia boards and soffits of the neighborhood's classic brick homes and multi-story buildings in the 11368 area. Our team is familiar with these property types and can safely access nests in any location.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Corona?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.
